tools/clang/test/SemaHLSL/const-expr.hlsl : 362-383
  -- DXC's own test codifies the divergence: the scalar case is accepted (365-366), the vector-component case is an expected-error with fxc-pass (379-382). A fix must update these.
==============================================================================
   362: 
   363:   static const uint sc_One = 1;
   364:   static const uint sc_Two = uint(sc_One) + 1;
   365:   float arr_sc_One[sc_One];
   366:   float arr_sc_Two[sc_Two];
   367: 
   368:   // Vector ints.
   369:   static uint1 v_One = 1;
   370:   static uint1 v_Two = uint1(v_One) + 1;
   371:   float arr_v_One[v_One];    /* expected-error {{size of array has non-integer type 'uint1'}} fxc-error {{X3058: array dimensions must be literal scalar expressions}} */
   372:   float arr_v_Two[v_Two];    /* expected-error {{size of array has non-integer type 'uint1'}} fxc-error {{X3058: array dimensions must be literal scalar expressions}} */
   373: 
   374:   static const uint1 vc_One = 1;
   375:   static const uint1 vc_Two = uint1(vc_One) + 1;
   376:   float arr_vc_One[vc_One];  /* expected-error {{size of array has non-integer type 'uint1'}} fxc-error {{X3058: array dimensions must be literal scalar expressions}} */
   377:   float arr_vc_Two[vc_Two];  /* expected-error {{size of array has non-integer type 'uint1'}} fxc-error {{X3058: array dimensions must be literal scalar expressions}} */
   378: 
   379:   // Note: here dxc is different from fxc, where a const integral vector can be used in ICE.
   380:   // It would be desirable to have this supported.
   381:   float arr_vc_One[vc_One.x];  /* expected-error {{variable length arrays are not supported in HLSL}} fxc-pass {{}} */
   382:   float arr_vc_Two[vc_Two.x];  /* expected-error {{variable length arrays are not supported in HLSL}} fxc-pass {{}} */
   383: }
